map.溶度积 Ksp 计算器，输入阴阳离子浓度与化学计量指数求 Ksp 或反求离子浓度: Solubility Product Ksp Calculator: enter ion concentrations and stoichiometric exponents to get Ksp, or back out ion concentrations, for precipitation and dissolution equilibrium analysis.
map.输入阴阳离子浓度与化学计量指数，求溶度积 Ksp。: Enter the ion concentrations and stoichiometric exponents to get the solubility product Ksp.

map.同离子效应：共离子降低溶解度。: Common ion effect: a shared ion lowers the solubility.

map.同离子效应？: What Is the Common Ion Effect?
map.共离子使溶解度降（勒夏特列原理）。: A common ion lowers the solubility (Le Chatelier's principle).
map.弱酸根盐（如 CaF₂）受 [H⁺] 影响（F⁻ 质子化），pH 升溶解度变。: Salts of weak acids (such as CaF₂) are affected by [H⁺] (F⁻ protonates), so the solubility changes as pH rises.
